chr.title: Chromosome
chr.description: Chromosome the variant lies on, prefixed with 'chr'. Scaffolds and patch regions use UCSC-style names.

rsid.title: dbSNP ID
rsid.description: dbSNP id for the variant position

ref.title: Reference Sequence
ref.description: Reference allele sequence at this position, empty for a pure insertion.

alt.title: Alternate Sequence
alt.description: Alternate allele sequence, empty for a pure deletion.

qual.title: Variant Call Quality
qual.description: Variant call quality score from VCF QUAL field.

variation_type.title: Variation Type
variation_type.description: Class of sequence change: SNP, insertion, deletion, or deletion-insertion.

spdi.title: SPDI Expression
spdi.description: Normalized SPDI expression identifying the allele.

hgvs.title: HGVS Expression
hgvs.description: HGVS genomic expression for the allele.

vrs_digest.title: VRS Allele Digest
vrs_digest.description: GA4GH Variation Representation Specification allele digest, a hash that is stable across equivalent representations of the same allele.

ca_id.title: Canonical Allele ID
ca_id.description: Canonical allele identifier assigned by the ClinGen Allele Registry.
